CONTRACT:
1. Address value/key decoding shares one canonical parser; accepted strings are fixed points and adversarial noncanonical mutations are rejected, including lowercase hex, %41, doubled/trailing slash, fullwidth/Arabic-Indic digits, NFC/NFD, %２F and %FF.
2. SM4SFT01 sidecar: 16-byte header (8-byte magic/version + uint64-LE payload length), finite LE Float32/Float64 row-major payload, full-file SHA-256, compact observed-only rows in canonical target order; Missing consumes no row.
3. SidecarTrack[T,V] retains FeatureSpace[V]; sealed SidecarValue[V] binds Double↔Scalar and Vector[Double]↔Vector(d), so wrong scalar/vector wires and materializers fail. Checked public SidecarLayout exposes overflow-safe offsets/strides for Atlas DataView/TypedArray adapters. Integrity is explicit, not confidentiality.
4. Atlas browser-boundary review accepted after witness/layout fixes at post-01M15AENYDS4SJB0GETPHB1CPD. Tiled/range-load integrity is deliberately follow-up bd-01M15ABW5GKR97CEWDQT8YCZM3.
